Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"unsupported","reason":"S602 says Target Off Block Time values are published through Airport CDM Portal, and S685 says Common Situation Display presents them, but no sentence states that Common Situation Display sends Target Off Block Time to Airport CDM Portal."}
